text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One evening, I spot an<n>exhausted-looking Grass
Wonder on<n>her way to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, so dizzy... The sky is there,<n>that's the ground,
and that's...<n>Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Tell me, Trainer, do you appreciate<n>how wonderful it
is... to have your<n>feet on solid ground?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Have you ever seen the red sports<n>car that is often
parked in the<n>academy's lot?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen offered to take me for a<n>spin in it, and I
regret to say I didn't<n>know better.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Have you ever wondered what it<n>would be like if
cars could fly? It's an<n>unforgettable experience...
Haha...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She giggles to herself while staring<n>off into space.
Note to self: steer<n>clear of the sports car.
